points.name: Head/Brain Reflex Zone (Foot)
points.description: Tips of all toes.

target.name: Brain
target.effect: Eases tension headache, sharpens mental clarity.
target.effectZh: 缓解紧张性头痛，提升头脑清晰度。

points.descriptionZh: 所有脚趾尖。

points.name: Kidney Reflex Zone (Foot)
points.description: Center of the sole.

target.name: Kidneys
target.effect: Stimulates kidney filtration, relieves lower-back tension.
target.effectZh: 促进肾脏排毒，缓解腰部紧张。

points.descriptionZh: 足底中央。

points.name: Liver Reflex Zone (Foot)
points.description: Upper right sole, right foot only.

target.name: Liver
target.effect: Supports detox function, eases right-shoulder tightness.
target.effectZh: 支持肝脏排毒，缓解右肩紧绷。

points.descriptionZh: 右足底上外侧，仅右脚。

points.name: Stomach Reflex Zone (Foot)
points.description: Mid-sole, just below the ball.
points.descriptionZh: 足底中部，前脚掌下方。

points.name: Hegu (LI4, Hand)
points.description: Web between thumb and index finger.

target.name: Face & Shoulder Muscles
target.effect: Relaxes facial and shoulder tension, relieves headache.
target.effectZh: 放松面部与肩部肌肉，缓解头痛。

points.descriptionZh: 拇指与食指之间的虎口。

points.name: Neiguan (PC6, Hand)
points.description: Inner forearm, above the wrist.
points.descriptionZh: 前臂内侧，腕横纹上方。

points.name: Shenmen (Ear)
points.description: Triangular fossa at the top of the ear.

target.name: Nervous System
target.effectZh: 降低应激反应，促进放松。

points.descriptionZh: 耳廓上部的三角窝。

points.name: Zusanli (ST36, Leg)
points.description: Below the knee, outer leg.
points.descriptionZh: 膝下，小腿外侧。

points.name: Baihui (GV20, Head)
points.description: Crown of the head — governing vessel.

target.name: Whole-Body Qi
target.effect: Calms the mind, lifts overall energy.
target.effectZh: 安神定志，提升整体气机。

points.descriptionZh: 头顶正中——督脉。

points.name: Sanyinjiao (SP6, Leg)
points.description: Inner ankle, above the bone.

target.name: Reproductive & Digestive Organs
target.effect: Regulates hormonal balance, eases menstrual cramps.
target.effectZh: 调节内分泌平衡，缓解经期不适。

points.descriptionZh: 内踝尖上方，胫骨后缘。

points.name: Heart
points.description: Pumps blood into the circulatory loop.
points.descriptionZh: 把血液泵入循环。

points.name: Aorta
points.description: Main artery leaving the heart.
points.descriptionZh: 离开心脏的主动脉。

points.name: Arteries
points.description: Carry oxygen-rich blood to tissues.
points.descriptionZh: 把富氧血输送到组织。

points.name: Capillaries
points.description: Exchange oxygen and nutrients at tissues.
points.descriptionZh: 在组织中交换氧气和养分。

points.name: Veins
points.description: Carry oxygen-poor blood back toward the heart.
points.descriptionZh: 把缺氧血送回心脏。

points.name: Vena Cava
points.description: Returns blood to the right atrium.
points.descriptionZh: 把血液送回右心房。

points.name: Lungs
points.description: Reoxygenates blood via pulmonary circulation.
points.descriptionZh: 经肺循环重新为血液充氧。

points.name: Hundred Convergences
points.description: On the midline of the head, 5 cun above the front hairline — where the line joining the ear tips crosses the midline.
points.descriptionZh: 头部，前发际正中直上5寸；两耳尖连线与头正中线的交点。

acu.uses: Headache, dizziness, insomnia, poor memory; traditionally lifts ‘sinking’ problems such as prolapse.
acu.usesZh: 头痛、眩晕、失眠、健忘；传统用于脱肛、子宫脱垂等下陷病证。
acu.needling: Transverse (flat under the scalp) 0.5–0.8 cun; moxibustion also used.

points.name: Hall of Impression
points.description: On the forehead, in the depression midway between the inner ends of the eyebrows.
points.descriptionZh: 额部，两眉毛内侧端中间的凹陷中。

acu.uses: Headache, dizziness, insomnia, anxiety, blocked or runny nose.
acu.usesZh: 头痛、眩晕、失眠、焦虑、鼻塞、鼻渊。
acu.needling: Pinch up the skin; transverse downward 0.3–0.5 cun.
acu.needlingZh: 提捏局部皮肤，向下平刺0.3–0.5寸。

points.name: Sun
points.description: At the temple, in the hollow about one finger-breadth behind the midpoint between the outer end of the eyebrow and the outer corner of the eye.
points.descriptionZh: 颞部，眉梢与目外眦之间，向后约一横指的凹陷中。

acu.uses: Headache (especially one-sided), migraine, red painful eyes, toothache, facial paralysis.
acu.usesZh: 头痛（尤其偏头痛）、目赤肿痛、牙痛、面瘫。
acu.needling: Perpendicular or oblique 0.3–0.5 cun, or prick to bleed.
acu.needlingZh: 直刺或斜刺0.3–0.5寸，或点刺出血。

points.name: Gathered Bamboo
points.description: In the depression at the inner end of the eyebrow, over the frontal notch.
points.descriptionZh: 面部，眉头凹陷中，额切迹处。

acu.uses: Frontal headache, eye strain, blurred vision, twitching eyelids, hiccups.
acu.usesZh: 前额头痛、目视不明、眼睑瞤动、目赤肿痛、呃逆。
acu.needling: Transverse 0.3–0.5 cun along the eyebrow. Close to the eye — moxibustion is not used.
acu.needlingZh: 平刺0.3–0.5寸；邻近眼部，不宜灸。

points.name: Welcome Fragrance
points.description: In the groove beside the nose (nasolabial fold), level with the midpoint of the outer edge of the nostril wing.
points.descriptionZh: 面部，鼻翼外缘中点旁，鼻唇沟中。

acu.uses: Blocked or runny nose, loss of smell, sinus congestion, nosebleed, facial itching.
acu.usesZh: 鼻塞、鼻渊、不闻香臭、鼻衄、面痒。
acu.needling: Oblique or transverse upward 0.3–0.5 cun.
acu.needlingZh: 向内上方斜刺或平刺0.3–0.5寸。

points.name: Water Trough
points.description: On the upper lip, one-third of the way down the groove under the nose (philtrum).
points.descriptionZh: 面部，人中沟的上1/3与中1/3交点处。

acu.uses: Traditional first aid for fainting, collapse and seizures; sudden low-back sprain.
acu.usesZh: 昏厥、休克、癫痫的传统急救穴；急性腰扭伤。
acu.needling: Oblique upward 0.3–0.5 cun, or strong fingernail pressure.
acu.needlingZh: 向上斜刺0.3–0.5寸，或用指甲重掐。

points.name: Jaw Vehicle
points.description: One finger-breadth in front of and above the angle of the jaw, on the muscle bulge when the teeth are clenched.
points.descriptionZh: 面部，下颌角前上方一横指，咀嚼时咬肌隆起处。

acu.uses: Toothache, jaw pain and stiffness, facial paralysis, swollen cheek.
acu.usesZh: 牙痛、颊肿、牙关紧闭、口眼歪斜。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.3–0.5 cun, or transverse toward Dicang (ST4) 0.5–1 cun.
acu.needlingZh: 直刺0.3–0.5寸，或向地仓方向平刺0.5–1寸。

points.name: Wind Screen
points.description: Behind the earlobe, in the hollow between the mastoid process and the angle of the jaw.
points.descriptionZh: 颈部，耳垂后方，乳突下端前方凹陷中。

acu.uses: Tinnitus, deafness, ear pain, facial paralysis, jaw pain, hiccups.
acu.usesZh: 耳鸣、耳聋、耳痛、口眼歪斜、颊肿、呃逆。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.5–1 cun.

points.name: Wind Pool
points.description: At the back of the neck under the skull, in the hollow between the upper ends of the sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles.
points.descriptionZh: 颈后区，枕骨之下，胸锁乳突肌上端与斜方肌上端之间的凹陷中。

acu.uses: Headache, dizziness, stiff neck, common cold, blurred vision, tinnitus, high blood pressure.
acu.usesZh: 头痛、眩晕、颈项强痛、感冒、目视不明、耳鸣、高血压。
acu.needling: Oblique toward the tip of the nose 0.8–1.2 cun. Never deep, upward or inward — the medulla lies beneath.
acu.needlingZh: 针尖微下，向鼻尖方向斜刺0.8–1.2寸；深部为延髓，严禁向内上方深刺。

points.name: Celestial Chimney
points.description: At the base of the throat, in the centre of the notch above the breastbone.
points.descriptionZh: 颈前区，胸骨上窝中央，前正中线上。

acu.uses: Cough, asthma, sore throat, sudden loss of voice, hiccups, a feeling of a lump in the throat.
acu.usesZh: 咳嗽、哮喘、咽喉肿痛、暴喑、呃逆、梅核气。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.2 cun, then turned down behind the breastbone 0.5–1 cun. Specialist technique — trachea, great vessels and lungs lie close.
acu.needlingZh: 先直刺0.2寸，再将针尖转向下方，紧贴胸骨柄后缘刺入0.5–1寸；邻近气管、大血管与肺，须由专业人员操作。

points.name: Cubit Marsh
points.description: On the elbow crease, in the hollow on the thumb side of the biceps tendon.
points.descriptionZh: 肘区，肘横纹上，肱二头肌腱桡侧缘凹陷中。

acu.uses: Cough, asthma, coughing blood, sore throat, fever, elbow and arm pain.
acu.usesZh: 咳嗽、气喘、咳血、咽喉肿痛、潮热、肘臂挛痛。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.8–1.2 cun, or prick the vein to bleed.

points.name: Broken Sequence
points.description: On the thumb side of the forearm, 1.5 cun above the wrist crease, just above the bony knob of the radius, in the groove of the abductor pollicis longus tendon.
points.descriptionZh: 前臂，腕掌侧远端横纹上1.5寸，桡骨茎突上方，拇短伸肌腱与拇长展肌腱之间。

acu.uses: Cough, headache, stiff neck, sore throat, facial paralysis, toothache.
acu.usesZh: 咳嗽、头痛、项强、咽喉痛、口眼歪斜、牙痛。
acu.needling: Oblique upward 0.3–0.5 cun.

points.name: Great Abyss
points.description: On the wrist crease at the thumb side, between the radial styloid and the scaphoid, just outside the radial pulse.
points.descriptionZh: 腕前区，桡骨茎突与舟状骨之间，拇长展肌腱尺侧凹陷中（桡动脉搏动处）。

acu.uses: Cough, asthma, weak pulse, chest pain, wrist pain.
acu.usesZh: 咳嗽、气喘、无脉症、胸痛、腕臂痛。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.3–0.5 cun, avoiding the radial artery.

points.name: Joining Valley
points.description: On the back of the hand, between the 1st and 2nd metacarpal bones, at the midpoint of the 2nd metacarpal on its thumb side.
points.descriptionZh: 手背，第1、2掌骨间，第2掌骨桡侧的中点处。

acu.uses: Headache, toothache, facial pain, sore throat, blocked nose, fever; one of the most used points for pain.
acu.usesZh: 头痛、牙痛、面痛、咽喉肿痛、鼻塞、发热；最常用的止痛穴之一。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.5–1 cun. Forbidden in pregnancy.

points.name: Arm Three Li
points.description: On the back-thumb side of the forearm, 2 cun below the elbow crease on the line from Yangxi (LI5) to Quchi (LI11).
points.descriptionZh: 前臂，肘横纹下2寸，阳溪与曲池连线上。

acu.uses: Elbow and arm pain, tennis elbow, shoulder pain, weak arm, toothache, abdominal pain, diarrhoea.
acu.usesZh: 肘臂疼痛、网球肘、肩痛、上肢不遂、齿痛、腹痛、腹泻。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–1.5 cun.

points.name: Pool at the Bend
points.description: At the outer end of the elbow crease with the elbow bent — midway between Chize (LU5) and the lateral epicondyle of the humerus.
points.descriptionZh: 肘区，屈肘，肘横纹外侧端，尺泽与肱骨外上髁连线的中点。

acu.uses: Fever, sore throat, rashes and itchy skin, high blood pressure, elbow and arm pain, abdominal pain.
acu.usesZh: 热病、咽喉肿痛、瘾疹湿疹、高血压、肘臂疼痛、腹痛吐泻。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–1.5 cun.

points.name: Shoulder Bone
points.description: On the shoulder, in the front hollow just below the tip of the acromion that appears when the arm is raised sideways.
points.descriptionZh: 肩区，肩峰外侧缘前端与肱骨大结节两骨间凹陷中（上臂外展时肩峰前下方凹陷）。

acu.uses: Shoulder pain and stiffness (frozen shoulder), inability to raise the arm, weakness of the arm.
acu.usesZh: 肩臂疼痛、肩周炎、上肢不遂、手臂不举。
acu.needling: Perpendicular or oblique downward 0.8–1.5 cun.

points.name: Marsh at the Bend
points.description: On the elbow crease, in the hollow on the little-finger side of the biceps tendon.
points.descriptionZh: 肘前区，肘横纹上，肱二头肌腱尺侧缘凹陷中。

acu.uses: Palpitations, chest pain, stomach ache, vomiting, fever, elbow and arm pain.
acu.usesZh: 心痛、心悸、胃痛、呕吐、热病、肘臂挛痛。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–1.5 cun, or prick the vein to bleed.

points.name: Lesser Sea
points.description: On the inner front of the elbow, level with the elbow crease, just in front of the medial epicondyle of the humerus.
points.descriptionZh: 肘前区，横平肘横纹，肱骨内上髁前缘。

acu.uses: Heart pain, elbow pain and numbness, hand tremor, swollen neck glands, forgetfulness.
acu.usesZh: 心痛、肘臂挛痛麻木、手颤、瘰疬、健忘。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.5–1 cun.

points.name: Small Sea
points.description: At the back of the elbow, in the groove between the tip of the olecranon and the medial epicondyle — over the ulnar nerve (the ‘funny bone’).
points.descriptionZh: 肘后区，尺骨鹰嘴与肱骨内上髁之间凹陷中（尺神经沟处）。

acu.uses: Elbow pain, pain along the back of the arm and shoulder, numb little finger, headache.
acu.usesZh: 肘臂疼痛、肩背痛、小指麻木、头痛。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.3–0.5 cun. The ulnar nerve lies here — an electric tingle means the needle has touched it.
acu.needlingZh: 直刺0.3–0.5寸；此处为尺神经，出现触电感说明触及神经。

points.name: Inner Pass
points.description: On the inner forearm, 2 cun above the wrist crease, between the tendons of palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis.
points.descriptionZh: 前臂前区，腕掌侧远端横纹上2寸，掌长肌腱与桡侧腕屈肌腱之间。

acu.uses: Nausea and vomiting (including motion and morning sickness), palpitations, chest tightness, insomnia, anxiety.
acu.usesZh: 恶心呕吐（含晕车、孕吐）、心悸、胸闷、失眠、焦虑。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.5–1 cun. The median nerve lies beneath — avoid strong lifting and thrusting.
acu.needlingZh: 直刺0.5–1寸；深部为正中神经，避免大幅提插。

points.name: Great Mound
points.description: In the middle of the wrist crease, between the tendons of palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis.
points.descriptionZh: 腕前区，腕掌侧远端横纹中点，掌长肌腱与桡侧腕屈肌腱之间。

acu.uses: Palpitations, chest pain, stomach pain, vomiting, anxiety, wrist pain (carpal tunnel).
acu.usesZh: 心痛、心悸、胃痛、呕吐、心烦、腕痛。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.3–0.5 cun.

points.name: Palace of Toil
points.description: In the centre of the palm, between the 2nd and 3rd metacarpals, where the middle fingertip rests in a loose fist.
points.descriptionZh: 掌区，横平第3掌指关节近端，第2、3掌骨之间偏于第3掌骨（握拳屈指时中指尖处）。

acu.uses: Mouth ulcers, bad breath, anxiety, fainting (first aid), sweaty palms.
acu.usesZh: 口疮、口臭、心烦、昏迷（急救）、鹅掌风、手汗。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.3–0.5 cun.

points.name: Spirit Gate
points.description: On the wrist crease at the little-finger side, in the hollow on the thumb side of the flexor carpi ulnaris tendon.
points.descriptionZh: 腕前区，腕掌侧远端横纹尺侧端，尺侧腕屈肌腱的桡侧缘。

acu.uses: Insomnia, anxiety, palpitations, poor memory, restlessness.
acu.usesZh: 失眠、焦虑、心悸、健忘、心烦。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.3–0.5 cun, avoiding the ulnar artery.

points.name: Outer Pass
points.description: On the back of the forearm, 2 cun above the wrist crease, midway between radius and ulna (opposite Neiguan).
points.descriptionZh: 前臂后区，腕背侧远端横纹上2寸，尺骨与桡骨间隙中点（与内关相对）。

acu.uses: Fever, colds, headache, tinnitus, deafness, neck and shoulder pain, wrist and hand pain.
acu.usesZh: 热病、感冒、头痛、耳鸣、耳聋、颈肩痛、手腕疼痛。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.5–1 cun.

points.name: Back Stream
points.description: On the little-finger edge of the hand, in the hollow just behind the 5th knuckle — the end of the palm crease in a loose fist.
points.descriptionZh: 手内侧，第5掌指关节尺侧近端赤白肉际凹陷中（握拳时掌横纹头）。

acu.uses: Stiff neck, low-back pain, headache, tinnitus, fever; traditionally opens the Governor Vessel along the spine.
acu.usesZh: 落枕、腰背痛、头项强痛、耳鸣、热病；八脉交会穴，通督脉。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.5–1 cun toward Hegu.

points.name: Central Residence
points.description: On the upper chest, 6 cun from the midline, level with the 1st intercostal space, 1 cun below the hollow under the outer collarbone.
points.descriptionZh: 胸部，横平第1肋间隙，锁骨下窝外侧，前正中线旁开6寸。

acu.uses: Cough, asthma, chest fullness and pain, shoulder and upper-back pain.
acu.usesZh: 咳嗽、气喘、胸满胸痛、肩背痛。
acu.needling: Oblique outward 0.5–0.8 cun. Never deep or toward the chest — risk of collapsed lung (pneumothorax).
acu.needlingZh: 向外斜刺0.5–0.8寸；不可向内深刺，以免伤及肺脏引起气胸。

points.name: Chest Centre
points.description: On the breastbone at the midline, level with the 4th intercostal space (between the nipples in men).
points.descriptionZh: 胸部，横平第4肋间隙，前正中线上（男性约两乳头连线中点）。

acu.uses: Chest tightness, shortness of breath, cough, palpitations, low breast-milk supply, hiccups.
acu.usesZh: 胸闷、气短、咳喘、心悸、乳少、呃逆。
acu.needling: Transverse 0.3–0.5 cun along the bone — some people have a hole in the breastbone here.
acu.needlingZh: 平刺0.3–0.5寸；部分人此处有胸骨裂孔，不可直刺深刺。

points.name: Middle Cavity
points.description: On the upper-abdomen midline, 4 cun above the navel (midway between the navel and the lower end of the breastbone).
points.descriptionZh: 上腹部，脐中上4寸，前正中线上（胸剑结合与脐中连线的中点）。

acu.uses: Stomach pain, bloating, nausea, vomiting, acid reflux, poor appetite, indigestion.
acu.usesZh: 胃痛、腹胀、恶心呕吐、吞酸、纳呆、消化不良。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–1.5 cun.

points.name: Spirit Gate Tower
points.description: In the centre of the navel.
points.descriptionZh: 脐区，脐中央。

acu.uses: Diarrhoea, cold abdominal pain, collapse (moxibustion), prolapse.
acu.usesZh: 泄泻、腹痛腹冷、虚脱（灸）、脱肛。
acu.needling: Needling is forbidden — moxibustion only (often over salt or ginger).
acu.needlingZh: 禁针；宜灸（常隔盐或隔姜灸）。

points.name: Sea of Qi
points.description: On the lower-abdomen midline, 1.5 cun below the navel.
points.descriptionZh: 下腹部，脐中下1.5寸，前正中线上。

acu.uses: Fatigue and weakness, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, constipation, irregular periods, frequent urination.
acu.usesZh: 虚劳乏力、腹痛、泄泻、便秘、月经不调、遗尿尿频。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–1.5 cun after emptying the bladder; moxibustion is common.
acu.needlingZh: 排尿后直刺1–1.5寸；多用灸法。

points.name: Origin Pass
points.description: On the lower-abdomen midline, 3 cun below the navel.
points.descriptionZh: 下腹部，脐中下3寸，前正中线上。

acu.uses: Weakness, frequent urination, irregular or painful periods, infertility, impotence, diarrhoea; a traditional strengthening point.
acu.usesZh: 虚劳、尿频、月经不调、痛经、不孕、阳痿、泄泻；传统强壮保健穴。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–1.5 cun after emptying the bladder.

points.name: Central Pole
points.description: On the lower-abdomen midline, 4 cun below the navel (1 cun above the pubic bone).
points.descriptionZh: 下腹部，脐中下4寸，前正中线上。

acu.uses: Urinary retention or frequency, painful urination, irregular periods, vaginal discharge.
acu.usesZh: 癃闭、尿频、尿痛、月经不调、带下。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–1.5 cun after emptying the bladder.

points.name: Celestial Pivot
points.description: On the abdomen, 2 cun to the side of the centre of the navel.
points.descriptionZh: 腹部，横平脐中，前正中线旁开2寸。

acu.uses: Constipation, diarrhoea, bloating, abdominal pain, irregular periods.
acu.usesZh: 便秘、泄泻、腹胀、腹痛、月经不调。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–1.5 cun.

points.name: Cycle Gate
points.description: On the chest, in the 6th intercostal space, 4 cun from the midline (straight below the nipple).
points.descriptionZh: 胸部，第6肋间隙，前正中线旁开4寸（乳头直下）。

acu.uses: Rib-side pain, chest fullness, belching, acid reflux, breast swelling, low mood.
acu.usesZh: 胸胁胀痛、嗳气、吞酸、乳痈、情志抑郁。
acu.needling: Oblique or transverse 0.5–0.8 cun. Never deep — lung and liver lie beneath.
acu.needlingZh: 斜刺或平刺0.5–0.8寸；不可深刺，以免伤及肺与肝。

points.name: Camphorwood Gate
points.description: On the side of the abdomen, just below the free end of the 11th rib.
points.descriptionZh: 侧腹部，第11肋游离端的下际。

acu.uses: Bloating, abdominal pain, indigestion, diarrhoea, rib-side pain.
acu.usesZh: 腹胀、腹痛、消化不良、泄泻、胁痛。
acu.needling: Oblique 0.5–0.8 cun; not deep (liver and spleen).
acu.needlingZh: 斜刺0.5–0.8寸；不可深刺，以免伤及肝脾。

points.name: Great Vertebra
points.description: On the back midline, in the hollow below the 7th cervical spinous process (the bony bump at the base of the neck).
points.descriptionZh: 脊柱区，第7颈椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。

acu.uses: Fever, colds, cough, stiff neck, heat conditions.
acu.usesZh: 热病、感冒、咳嗽、颈项强痛、骨蒸潮热。
acu.needling: Oblique upward 0.5–1 cun; not deep (spinal cord).
acu.needlingZh: 向上斜刺0.5–1寸；不可深刺，以免伤及脊髓。

points.name: Shoulder Well
points.description: On the top of the shoulder, midway between the 7th cervical spinous process and the outer tip of the acromion.
points.descriptionZh: 肩胛区，第7颈椎棘突与肩峰最外侧点连线的中点。

acu.uses: Neck and shoulder pain and stiffness, headache, difficult labour, breast abscess, low milk supply.
acu.usesZh: 颈项强痛、肩背疼痛、头痛、难产、乳痈、乳汁不下。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.5–0.8 cun only — the top of the lung lies beneath. Forbidden in pregnancy.
acu.needlingZh: 直刺0.5–0.8寸；深部正当肺尖，不可深刺。孕妇禁针。

points.name: Celestial Gathering
points.description: On the shoulder blade, in the hollow one-third of the way from the midpoint of the scapular spine to its lower angle.
points.descriptionZh: 肩胛区，肩胛冈中点与肩胛骨下角连线上1/3与下2/3交点凹陷中。

acu.uses: Shoulder-blade pain, upper back and arm pain, breast pain, low milk supply.
acu.usesZh: 肩胛疼痛、肩背部损伤、乳痈、乳少。
acu.needling: Perpendicular or oblique 0.5–1 cun (over the shoulder blade).

points.name: Lung Shu
points.description: On the upper back, 1.5 cun to the side of the lower border of the 3rd thoracic spinous process.
points.descriptionZh: 脊柱区，第3胸椎棘突下，后正中线旁开1.5寸。

acu.uses: Cough, asthma, coughing blood, night sweats, itchy skin.
acu.usesZh: 咳嗽、气喘、咯血、盗汗、皮肤瘙痒。
acu.needling: Oblique toward the spine 0.5–0.8 cun. Never deep — risk of collapsed lung (pneumothorax).
acu.needlingZh: 向脊柱方向斜刺0.5–0.8寸；不宜深刺，以免引起气胸。

points.name: Heart Shu
points.description: On the upper back, 1.5 cun to the side of the lower border of the 5th thoracic spinous process.
points.descriptionZh: 脊柱区，第5胸椎棘突下，后正中线旁开1.5寸。

acu.uses: Palpitations, chest pain, insomnia, forgetfulness, anxiety, night sweats.
acu.usesZh: 心悸、胸痛、失眠、健忘、心烦、盗汗。
acu.needling: Oblique toward the spine 0.5–0.8 cun. Never deep — risk of collapsed lung (pneumothorax).
acu.needlingZh: 向脊柱方向斜刺0.5–0.8寸；不宜深刺，以免引起气胸。

points.name: Diaphragm Shu
points.description: On the upper back, 1.5 cun to the side of the lower border of the 7th thoracic spinous process.
points.descriptionZh: 脊柱区，第7胸椎棘突下，后正中线旁开1.5寸。

acu.uses: Hiccups, vomiting, anaemia, coughing blood, hives; traditionally the ‘meeting point of blood’.
acu.usesZh: 呃逆、呕吐、贫血、咳血、瘾疹；血会。
acu.needling: Oblique toward the spine 0.5–0.8 cun. Never deep — risk of collapsed lung (pneumothorax).
acu.needlingZh: 向脊柱方向斜刺0.5–0.8寸；不宜深刺，以免引起气胸。

points.name: Liver Shu
points.description: On the upper back, 1.5 cun to the side of the lower border of the 9th thoracic spinous process.
points.descriptionZh: 脊柱区，第9胸椎棘突下，后正中线旁开1.5寸。

acu.uses: Rib-side pain, jaundice, red eyes, poor night vision, dizziness, irritability.
acu.usesZh: 胁痛、黄疸、目赤、夜盲、眩晕、急躁易怒。
acu.needling: Oblique toward the spine 0.5–0.8 cun. Never deep — risk of collapsed lung (pneumothorax).
acu.needlingZh: 向脊柱方向斜刺0.5–0.8寸；不宜深刺，以免引起气胸。

points.name: Spleen Shu
points.description: On the upper back, 1.5 cun to the side of the lower border of the 11th thoracic spinous process.
points.descriptionZh: 脊柱区，第11胸椎棘突下，后正中线旁开1.5寸。

acu.uses: Bloating, poor appetite, diarrhoea, fatigue, swelling.
acu.usesZh: 腹胀、纳呆、泄泻、倦怠乏力、水肿。
acu.needling: Oblique toward the spine 0.5–0.8 cun. Never deep — risk of collapsed lung (pneumothorax).
acu.needlingZh: 向脊柱方向斜刺0.5–0.8寸；不宜深刺，以免引起气胸。

points.name: Kidney Shu
points.description: On the lower back, 1.5 cun to the side of the lower border of the 2nd lumbar spinous process (about waist level).
points.descriptionZh: 脊柱区，第2腰椎棘突下，后正中线旁开1.5寸。

acu.uses: Low-back pain, frequent urination, bedwetting, impotence, irregular periods, tinnitus, swelling.
acu.usesZh: 腰痛、尿频、遗尿、阳痿、月经不调、耳鸣、水肿。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.5–1 cun; not deep toward the kidney.

points.name: Gate of Life
points.description: On the lower-back midline, in the hollow below the 2nd lumbar spinous process (between the two Shenshu).
points.descriptionZh: 脊柱区，第2腰椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。

acu.uses: Low-back pain and stiffness, cold limbs, impotence, frequent urination, chronic diarrhoea.
acu.usesZh: 腰脊强痛、手足逆冷、阳痿、尿频、久泻。
acu.needling: Oblique upward 0.5–1 cun; moxibustion is common.

points.name: Large Intestine Shu
points.description: On the lower back, 1.5 cun to the side of the lower border of the 4th lumbar spinous process.
points.descriptionZh: 脊柱区，第4腰椎棘突下，后正中线旁开1.5寸。

acu.uses: Low-back pain, sciatica, constipation, diarrhoea, bloating.
acu.usesZh: 腰腿痛、便秘、泄泻、腹胀。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.8–1.2 cun.

points.name: Second Crevice
points.description: On the sacrum, over the 2nd posterior sacral foramen.
points.descriptionZh: 骶区，正对第2骶后孔中。

acu.uses: Painful or irregular periods, low-back and sacral pain, urinary problems, sciatica.
acu.usesZh: 痛经、月经不调、腰骶痛、小便不利、下肢痿痹。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–1.5 cun into the foramen.

points.name: Jumping Circle
points.description: On the buttock, one-third of the way from the top of the greater trochanter toward the sacral hiatus.
points.descriptionZh: 臀区，股骨大转子最凸点与骶管裂孔连线的外1/3与中1/3交点处。

acu.uses: Sciatica, hip pain, low-back and leg pain, weakness of the leg.
acu.usesZh: 坐骨神经痛、髋痛、腰腿痛、下肢痿痹。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 2–3 cun through the thick muscle; the sciatic nerve lies close.
acu.needlingZh: 直刺2–3寸；深部邻近坐骨神经。

points.name: Wind Market
points.description: On the outer thigh, where the tip of the middle finger rests when standing with the arms at the sides (7 cun above the knee crease).
points.descriptionZh: 股部，直立垂手、掌心贴于大腿时中指尖所指凹陷中，髂胫束后缘（腘横纹上7寸）。

acu.uses: Itching all over, hives, numb or weak legs, sciatica.
acu.usesZh: 遍身瘙痒、瘾疹、下肢痿痹、麻木、坐骨神经痛。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–2 cun.

points.name: Sea of Blood
points.description: On the inner thigh, 2 cun above the upper inner corner of the kneecap, on the bulge of the vastus medialis.
points.descriptionZh: 股前区，髌底内侧端上2寸，股内侧肌隆起处。

acu.uses: Irregular or painful periods, eczema, hives, itchy skin, knee pain.
acu.usesZh: 月经不调、痛经、湿疹、瘾疹、皮肤瘙痒、膝痛。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–1.5 cun.

points.name: Calf's Nose
points.description: Below the kneecap, in the hollow on the outer side of the patellar tendon (the outer ‘eye of the knee’).
points.descriptionZh: 膝前区，髌韧带外侧凹陷中（外膝眼）。

acu.uses: Knee pain, swelling and stiffness, arthritis of the knee.
acu.usesZh: 膝痛、膝关节肿胀、屈伸不利。
acu.needling: With the knee bent, oblique toward the centre of the knee 0.5–1 cun; strict sterility (near the joint space).
acu.needlingZh: 屈膝，向膝中斜刺0.5–1寸；邻近关节腔，须严格消毒。

points.name: Yin Mound Spring
points.description: On the inner leg, in the hollow where the lower edge of the medial condyle of the tibia meets its inner border.
points.descriptionZh: 小腿内侧，胫骨内侧髁下缘与胫骨内侧缘之间的凹陷中。

acu.uses: Swelling and water retention, difficult urination, diarrhoea, bloating, knee pain.
acu.usesZh: 水肿、小便不利、泄泻、腹胀、膝痛。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–2 cun.

points.name: Yang Mound Spring
points.description: On the outer leg, in the hollow in front of and below the head of the fibula.
points.descriptionZh: 小腿外侧，腓骨头前下方凹陷中。

acu.uses: Knee pain, numb legs and cramps, sciatica, rib-side pain, bitter taste, nausea; traditionally the ‘meeting point of sinews’.
acu.usesZh: 膝肿痛、下肢痿痹麻木、抽筋、胁痛、口苦、呕吐；筋会。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–1.5 cun; the common peroneal nerve lies close behind.
acu.needlingZh: 直刺1–1.5寸；后方邻近腓总神经。

points.name: Leg Three Li
points.description: On the front of the leg, 3 cun below Dubi (ST35), one finger-breadth outside the front edge of the tibia.
points.descriptionZh: 小腿外侧，犊鼻下3寸，胫骨前嵴外一横指处。

acu.uses: Stomach pain, nausea, bloating, diarrhoea, constipation, fatigue, knee pain; the classic point for general wellbeing.
acu.usesZh: 胃痛、呕吐、腹胀、泄泻、便秘、虚劳乏力、膝痛；强壮保健要穴。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–2 cun; moxibustion is common.

points.name: Bend Middle
points.description: At the back of the knee, at the midpoint of the knee crease.
points.descriptionZh: 膝后区，腘横纹中点。

acu.uses: Low-back pain (‘for the back, look to Weizhong’), sciatica, knee pain, heat stroke, skin rashes.
acu.usesZh: 腰背痛（腰背委中求）、坐骨神经痛、膝痛、中暑、丹毒。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–1.5 cun, or prick the small veins to bleed. The popliteal artery and tibial nerve lie deep — no deep, forceful needling.
acu.needlingZh: 直刺1–1.5寸，或点刺腘静脉出血；深部有腘动脉与胫神经，不宜深刺、强刺激。

points.name: Abundant Bulge
points.description: On the outer leg, 8 cun above the outer ankle bone (midway between knee and ankle), two finger-breadths outside the front edge of the tibia.
points.descriptionZh: 小腿外侧，外踝尖上8寸，胫骨前肌外缘（条口旁开1寸）。

acu.uses: Phlegm and cough, asthma, dizziness, headache, chest tightness, constipation.
acu.usesZh: 痰多、咳嗽、哮喘、眩晕、头痛、胸闷、便秘。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–1.5 cun.

points.name: Mountain Support
points.description: At the back of the lower leg, in the pointed hollow below the two bellies of the calf muscle that appears on tiptoe.
points.descriptionZh: 小腿后区，腓肠肌两肌腹与肌腱交角处（踮脚时出现的尖角凹陷）。

acu.uses: Calf cramps, low-back and leg pain, sciatica, haemorrhoids, constipation.
acu.usesZh: 小腿抽筋、腰腿痛、坐骨神经痛、痔疮、便秘。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–2 cun.

points.name: Three Yin Intersection
points.description: On the inner leg, 3 cun above the tip of the inner ankle bone, just behind the inner edge of the tibia.
points.descriptionZh: 小腿内侧，内踝尖上3寸，胫骨内侧缘后际。

acu.uses: Painful or irregular periods, infertility, insomnia, bloating, diarrhoea, frequent urination; traditionally used to bring on labour.
acu.usesZh: 痛经、月经不调、不孕、失眠、腹胀、泄泻、尿频；传统用于催产。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 1–1.5 cun. Forbidden in pregnancy.

points.name: Suspended Bell
points.description: On the outer leg, 3 cun above the tip of the outer ankle bone, in front of the fibula.
points.descriptionZh: 小腿外侧，外踝尖上3寸，腓骨前缘。

acu.uses: Stiff neck, leg pain and weakness, ankle pain, rib-side pain; traditionally the ‘meeting point of marrow’.
acu.usesZh: 颈项强痛、下肢痿痹、踝痛、胁痛；髓会。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.5–0.8 cun.

points.name: Great Stream
points.description: On the inner ankle, in the hollow between the tip of the inner ankle bone and the Achilles tendon.
points.descriptionZh: 踝区，内踝尖与跟腱之间的凹陷中。

acu.uses: Low-back pain, tinnitus, sore throat, toothache, insomnia, frequent urination, irregular periods.
acu.usesZh: 腰痛、耳鸣、咽喉肿痛、牙痛、失眠、尿频、月经不调。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.5–1 cun; the posterior tibial artery lies close.

points.name: Kunlun Mountains
points.description: On the outer ankle, in the hollow between the tip of the outer ankle bone and the Achilles tendon.
points.descriptionZh: 踝区，外踝尖与跟腱之间的凹陷中。

acu.uses: Headache, stiff neck, low-back pain, heel and ankle pain; traditionally used for difficult labour.
acu.usesZh: 头痛、项强、腰骶疼痛、足跟肿痛；传统用于难产。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.5–0.8 cun. Forbidden in pregnancy.

points.name: Grandfather Grandson
points.description: On the inner edge of the foot, in the hollow in front of and below the base of the 1st metatarsal, where the skin changes colour.
points.descriptionZh: 跖区，第1跖骨底的前下缘赤白肉际处。

acu.uses: Stomach pain, vomiting, bloating, diarrhoea, chest discomfort.
acu.usesZh: 胃痛、呕吐、腹胀、泄泻、胸闷。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.6–1.2 cun.

points.name: Great Rush
points.description: On the top of the foot, in the hollow between the 1st and 2nd metatarsals, just in front of where their bases meet.
points.descriptionZh: 足背，第1、2跖骨间，跖骨底结合部前方凹陷中。

acu.uses: Headache, dizziness, irritability and stress, red eyes, high blood pressure, painful periods, rib-side pain; with Hegu, the ‘Four Gates’ for calming and pain.
acu.usesZh: 头痛、眩晕、急躁易怒、目赤、高血压、痛经、胁痛；与合谷合称“四关”，镇静止痛。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.5–0.8 cun.

points.name: Inner Court
points.description: On the top of the foot, at the web between the 2nd and 3rd toes, where the skin changes colour.
points.descriptionZh: 足背，第2、3趾间，趾蹼缘后方赤白肉际处。

acu.uses: Toothache, sore throat, nosebleed, stomach pain, acid reflux, fever.
acu.usesZh: 牙痛、咽喉肿痛、鼻衄、胃痛吐酸、热病。
acu.needling: Perpendicular or oblique 0.5–0.8 cun.

points.name: Gushing Spring
points.description: On the sole, in the deepest hollow when the toes are curled — about one-third of the way from the base of the 2nd and 3rd toes to the heel.
points.descriptionZh: 足底，屈足卷趾时足心最凹陷处；约当第2、3趾蹼缘与足跟连线的前1/3与后2/3交点。

acu.uses: Headache, dizziness, insomnia, fainting (first aid), sore throat, constipation; often used for moxibustion or massage.
acu.usesZh: 头痛、眩晕、失眠、昏厥（急救）、咽喉痛、便秘；常用灸法或按摩。
acu.needling: Perpendicular 0.5–1 cun; very sensitive.

points.name: Reaching Yin
points.description: On the little toe, 0.1 cun from the outer corner of the toenail.
points.descriptionZh: 足趾，小趾末节外侧，趾甲根角侧后方0.1寸。

acu.uses: Traditionally, moxibustion here is used to turn a breech baby (from about 33 weeks, under supervision); headache, blocked nose.
acu.usesZh: 传统用艾灸矫正胎位不正（约孕33周起，须在医生指导下）；头痛、鼻塞。
acu.needling: Shallow 0.1 cun, or prick to bleed; moxibustion.
acu.needlingZh: 浅刺0.1寸，或点刺出血；可灸。
